protocol.purpose: Predeclared fourteen-day wet/dry initialization sensitivity with qualified exact numerical backend; not calibration
protocol.initial: Same previous post-conversion atmospheric T/water and globally balanced open-mean source wind. Surface starts from archived simulated ground temperature reduced to sea level with fixed6K/km; initial transfer rain and actual liquidH returned before run, excluded from run rain.

omitted_upper.description: Fixed exterior isothermal emitting slab above380hPa. T from initial6K/km source profile at p_top/2 with200K floor; dry tau uses declared dry opacity times omitted pressure mass. DownwardLW=sigma*T^4*(1-exp(-tau_above)). This is an externally maintained partial-column boundary, NOT TOA.

protocol.forcing: Daily-mean Earth-orbit solar at evolving source day, prescribed25% outside reflection and drySW attenuation through omitted upper air; greyLW depth=kappa_dry*Md+.025*W, updates with actual vapor. Neutral loglaw at explicit initial pressure-derived reference height; signed dew/evap; finite liquid/heat reservoir. No forced temperature restoration.
protocol.paired_control: Same forcing physics/parameters, T/vapor, source wind, orbit and lateral fields. Wet starts with50kg/m² land liquid, dry with0, plus separately returned initial pressure-conversion rain. Wet900/450 timestep comparison; dry900 is coarse sensitivity screen, not dry-branch numerical acceptance.
protocol.approximation: Exploratory grey optical depths and neutral roughness are declared choices, not measured or Earth-fitted opacities. No clouds/spectral scattering, surface stability/gusts, ice/runoff/deep heating, terrain or nonlinear momentum. Daily-mean rather than diurnal forcing. Partial upper boundary and lateral fields held externally.
protocol.energy_water: All actual vapor enthalpy/sensible exchange debited from finite surface; phase/dynamic rain returns mass and actual liquidH exactly once and changes surface heat capacity. Total gas+kinetic+surface E changes only by declared radiation/top/lateral power; total atmospheric+surfacewater changes only by lateral vapor transport.
protocol.failure: Reject exhausted surface/airwater or out-of-domain temperatures; preserve all failures/partials; no parameter changes, clipped sources, replacement cases or adaptive post-outcome tuning.
protocol.counts: Three new Earth-input prototype integrations in this plan, one per region; wet/dry plans together add six after87starts/83completions/four retained failures. No new legacy benchmarks.
protocol.daily_checkpoints: Save actual states and day-specific rainfall at24/48/72h. Compare wet day1 against previous24h same-dt result to check orchestration reproducibility. Last-day statistics use fixed48–72h window only when complete. No steady-state or monthly-skill claim.
protocol.initial_condition_scope: Land liquid is uncertain initial storage, not a fitted rainfall parameter or inferred soil truth. Ocean10m liquid/heat reservoir unchanged. No physical parameters changed between wet/dry. No post-outcome parameter adaptation or replacement cases.

analysis_protocol.first_three_days: Compare all six coarse wet/dry trajectories against corresponding prior72h900s archive, with max absolute temperature/water/velocity/rain differences <=1e-6 and rain enthalpy <=0.1J/m2; report all actual differences. Shared numerical backend may differ from original phase bisection at floating precision.
analysis_protocol.water_diagnosis: Compute daily land rainfall, evaporation=P-delta(surface liquid), net whole-column horizontal water import=delta(vapor+surface liquid), temperatures and wet/dry gaps. Reconstruct saved whole-domain energy/water against cumulative sources for every day, not just final.
analysis_protocol.spinup_assessment: Report day3/day7/day14 state gaps and days8-14 rain means and linear soil storage trends, including maps/RMS. No threshold for choosing an initialization; no unconditional convergence claim or proof of equilibria. Seasonal solar changes and fixed lateral reservoirs remain explicit.
analysis_protocol.stopping: Always attempt declared14days for each case. Preserve failures/partial histories; no automatic parameter changes or replacement. No early stop for rain score, no fitted soil state, no observed wind/humidity data.
analysis_protocol.scope: Flat terrain, deep lowest air cell, neutral bulk exchange, liquid-only thermodynamics, partial380hPa top and frozen lateral initial reservoirs remain approximations. This is extended transient sensitivity, not climatological rainfall skill.

run.scope: Fourteen-day initial-land-water sensitivity smoke with fixed daily checkpoints, fixed declared grey/neutral flux assumptions and finite surface water/energy. Partial380hPa top has explicit exterior solar/LW, not TOA. No observed data, terrain/nonlinear momentum, monthly calibration or adoption.

daily_checks.scope: Read-only snapshot. Empty future days are not outcomes; no replacement or fitted initialization. Daily budgets reconstructed from saved fields and actual recorded supplies. No monthly skill or physical adoption.
